chapters.label: Sudden death, live
chapters.text: Moscow, 2008, pouring rain. Champions League final, sudden death. Nicolas Anelka must score for Chelsea. Edwin van der Sar points left... then dives right. Saved! Manchester United are champions!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch it again, slowly. Van der Sar had studied Chelsea's penalties. He stays patient, waits for the kick, and pushes it away.

chapters.label: From behind the goal
chapters.text: From behind the goal: his teammates race through the rain to hug him.

chapters.label: The secret
chapters.text: The secret? Keepers, do your homework and stay calm. A little bluff and a patient wait can win a shootout, and brave kickers step up again.
